name: governed-trader
description: A governed paper-trading agent: a trade is the canonical irreversible action, so the policy gate is the point. Ungoverned breaches risk limits; governed breaches 0 at ~zero return cost. Eval on real, frozen crypto data. No real money, ever.

scripts.test: node tests/gate.selftest.js && node tests/conductor.selftest.js && node tests/audit.selftest.js
